description: This Java source file defines the MessageString class, which encapsulates information about messages such as error or informational messages within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class includes fields for message text, associated fields, error status, locale, and property resource details. It provides static methods for filtering messages based on associated fields and multiple constructors for creating message instances with varying details.
